guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster / Reverend / Gibson Les Paul
guitar.notes: Accurate: Corgan known for Stratocaster and later Reverend signature; Iha used Les Paul/various.

tone.target: bright layered alt-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright layered alt-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A bright, modulated alt-rock crunch tone using a clean boost and chorus into an AC30-style amp for layered stereo depth.
corrections: Keep chorus as the key signature

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide clean-to-crunch breakup and boost upper mids.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used for its bright, mid-focused character suitable for alt-rock crunch.

blocks.purpose: Create the key modulated lead sheen and layered stereo feel.
Add controlled crunch and grit for the alt-rock texture without heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: The RAT is chosen to provide aggressive, mid-focused breakup suitable for Smashing Pumpkins' sound palette.

alternatives.reason: A more general option if the crunch needs less bite.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, articulate British alt-rock tone.
Provide a classic, bright British cabinet voicing.
Enhance the bright upper mids and overall clarity.
Add subtle depth and layered stereo feel without sounding muddy.
Add subtle rhythmic echo for dimension (avoiding dotted-eighth).
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to add depth without dominating the mix.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to better capture the bright, layered alt-rock sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance upper mids and articulate crunch for Smashing Pumpkins' signature tone.
